## 2. Research Questions

You must propose **at least two** of the following analysis types.

### 2.1 Regression Question

* What **numeric outcome** are you predicting?
* What are your **main predictors**?
* Why is a **continuous outcome** appropriate here?

> *Example prompt:*
> “Can we predict ___ based on ___, ___, and ___?”

---

### 2.2 Classification Question

* What is your **target class**?
* How are the classes defined?
* Is there **class imbalance**?

> *Example prompt:*
> “Can we classify whether an observation belongs to ___ based on ___ features?”

---

### 2.3 Clustering Question (Optional if using both Regression + Classification)

* What groups do you expect to emerge?
* What would those groups **mean in the real world**?

> *Example prompt:*
> “Do natural groupings exist among ___ based on ___ features?”
